records.name: Moment assembly
records.map: sum of weight and every inserted numerator
records.laws: arity-zero zero; unary identity; associativity; permutation symmetry

records.name: Partition pushforward
records.signature: finite configuration moment arrays + partition -> block moment arrays
records.map: sum moment vectors on each fibre
records.preconditions: All declared inserted numerators retained, including zero-weight fibres

records.name: Estimator decoding
records.signature: moment vector -> ordinary estimator tuple, partial
records.map: n_j/w for nonzero w; arbitrary values if w=0 and every n_j=0

records.name: Absolute-weight contraction certificate
records.signature: finite moment pushforward with fixed positive Z -> d_prime>=d
records.preconditions: No Z-changing approximation; cost and strictness not inferred

records.name: Phase reweighting identity
records.signature: integrable estimator with W finite and d>0 -> original normalized observable
records.preconditions: Replacing w by absolute w alone is not the claimed representation change

records.name: Kramers positivity certificate
records.signature: finite complex B and antiunitary T, T^2=-I, TB=BT -> det(I+B)>=0
records.map: conjugate generalized-eigenvalue pairs and even real multiplicities
records.preconditions: For an auxiliary-field application require each field and positive remaining factors

records.name: Spectral representation
records.signature: finite Hermitian H + observables -> positive thermal weights and diagonal insertions
records.preconditions: Spectral theorem; no efficient construction or sampling conclusion

records.name: Reduction admission gate
records.signature: candidate family reduction -> scoped claim or refusal
records.map: check model and numerator identities, representation scope, algorithm costs and evidence statuses
records.preconditions: Unknown evidence stays unknown; finite fit cannot promote asymptotic theorem

formalization: No operad library, compiler or Lean verification was executed. FS-OP-01 is a genuine elementary algebra over the commutative operad; other records are typed reusable operations or gates, not a claim that they form one verified operad.
